steps.text: The early IMU trace shows the backward tip begins within the first 10 steps, despite commanding the starting angles. I’m updating the driver to make small feedback corrections from IMU tilt and angular velocity every 10 steps, beginning at the initial pose.

+"""Balance-board driver for the eai-standard/2.1 robot service."""
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+def normalized_targets(ranges, radians):
+    lo, hi = ranges[:, 0], ranges[:, 1]
+    return np.clip(2.0 * (np.asarray(radians) - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1.0, -1.0, 1.0).astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def run(steps=1000, reset=True, chunk=10, kp_pitch=0.8, kd_pitch=0.08,
+        kp_roll=0.25, kd_roll=0.04, save_dir="/app/output/latest"):
+    r = Robot()
+    spec = r.spec()
+    ranges = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
+    obs = r.reset(cameras=["room_camera"]) if reset else r.get_obs(cameras=["room_camera"], video="none")
+    q0 = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:19], dtype=float)
+    # Base is the observed starting pose. IMU feedback changes hip/ankle targets.
+    base = q0.copy()
+    latest = obs
+    while not latest.done and latest.meta["control_steps"] < steps:
+        state = np.asarray(latest.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        gx, gy = state[41], state[42]
+        wx, wy = state[38], state[39]
+        # Gravity components point toward the lean. Rate terms anticipate the tip.
+        pitch = np.clip(-(kp_pitch * gx + kd_pitch * wy), -0.45, 0.45)
+        roll = np.clip(-(kp_roll * gy + kd_roll * wx), -0.20, 0.20)
+        target = base.copy()
+        target[[2, 7]] += pitch
+        target[[4, 9]] += 0.30 * pitch
+        target[[1, 6]] += roll
+        target[10] = base[10]
+        action = normalized_targets(ranges, target)
+        count = min(chunk, steps - latest.meta["control_steps"])
+        latest = r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(action[None, :], count, axis=0),
+                          dt=spec["control_dt"], interpolate="hold",
+                          cameras=["room_camera"], video="none")
+        s = np.asarray(latest.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        print(latest.meta["control_steps"], "tilt", np.round(s[41:44], 3),
+              "gyro", np.round(s[38:41], 3), "done", latest.done)
+    latest.save(save_dir)
+    print("final", latest.meta)
+    return latest
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    run()
*** End Patch";
